settings.name_in_paper: Meta-learning for Online Bayesian Persuasion, full feedback
unmapped: Meta-learning: a sequence of T_tasks persuasion tasks, each of m_rounds rounds; objective is task-averaged regret (average over tasks of per-task regret)

Bayesian persuasion: sender chooses direct persuasive signaling schemes; oblivious adversary picks receiver types; learning is done in the K_types-dimensional loss space conv(nu(P)) via a Caratheodory oracle and inverse map nu^dagger
Full feedback: sender observes the receiver type each round
Learner knows m_rounds, T_tasks and K_types (used in tuning)
settings.definition_quote: We assume that the sequence of receiver's type profiles $\{k_i\}_{i \in [m]}$, with $k_i \in \mathcal{K}$, is selected by an oblivious adversary. ... In the \emph{full feedback} setting, the sender gets to know the receiver's type profile $k_i$

settings.name_in_paper: Meta-learning for Online Bayesian Persuasion, partial (bandit) feedback
unmapped: Meta-learning over T_tasks tasks of m_rounds rounds each; task-averaged regret
Bayesian persuasion as bandit linear optimization over conv(nu(P)) in R^{K_types}, only the scalar loss in [0,1] observed
settings.definition_quote: we assume that only a scalar loss value is revealed to the sender after interacting with the environment, as in the standard Bandit Linear Optimization (BLO) framework. Formally, at each round $i$ of task $t$ we observe loss $ \langle \nu(\phi^t_i), \mathbf{1}_{k^t_i}\rangle = \langle \ell^t_{i}, \mathbf{\phi}^t_{i} \rangle \in [0,1]$

settings.name_in_paper: Meta-learning for Markov Persuasion Processes, full feedback
settings.out_of_scope_reason: Episodic loop-free Markov persuasion process (MDP-based episodic RL with persuasiveness constraints).
unmapped: Meta-learning: task parameters (transitions, priors, reward means) drawn i.i.d. across tasks around global means with bounded across-task variance
Learner knows within-task and across-task variances (Assumption 4.1), used to set similarity parameter kappa
Persuasiveness constraints with cumulative violation metric
settings.definition_quote: an episodic MPP is defined by a tuple for the task $t \in [T]$ as $M \coloneqq ( X,A,\Omega,\mu, P,\{u_i^s \}^{m}_{i=1},\{u_i^r \}^{m}_{i=1})$ ... full $\to u_i^{s,t}(x_k,\omega_k,a),\, u_i^{r,t}(x_k,\omega_k,a)\ \ \forall a \in A$

settings.name_in_paper: Meta-learning for Markov Persuasion Processes, partial feedback
settings.out_of_scope_reason: Episodic loop-free Markov persuasion process (MDP-based episodic RL with persuasiveness constraints).
unmapped: Meta-learning across tasks with i.i.d. task parameters around global means
Learner knows within-task and across-task variances (Assumption 4.1)
Partial feedback: only rewards of the recommended actions along the trajectory observed

algorithms.name: Full-feedback Meta-Persuasion (OGD in loss space + epsilon-EWOO)
Partial-Feedback Meta-Persuasion (CTOMD + exponential weights over (eta,b) grid)
CTOMD (Caratheodory-augmented SCRiBLe-type OMD with self-concordant barrier)

symbols.m_rounds: number of rounds per task (paper's m)
symbols.K_types: number of receiver types = dimension of loss space (paper's K)
symbols.V_z: empirical variance of per-task optimal loss-space points z^{*(t)} = nu(phi^{*(t)})

conditions: oblivious adversary chooses receiver types within each task

source.label: thm:OBP-full-fb
source.quote: Algorithm~\ref{alg:omd-tuning-fb} with parameters \( \epsilon = \rho A, \) \( \rho = T^{-1/4}, \) \( A = \sqrt{\frac{K}{m}}, \) \( \beta = \frac{4}{mA}\min\{\frac{\epsilon^2}{A^2},1\} \) achieves task-averaged regret \( R_m^T = O\!\left( \sqrt{\, m \, \mathrm{Var}\!\left(\{z^{*(t)}\}_{t=1}^T\right)} \;\right) \) \( \text{as } T \to \infty, \)

results.notes: Bound is on the task-averaged regret (per-task regret averaged over tasks), not total regret over T*m rounds. Appendix version adds o_T(poly(m,K)). Per-task regret expectation over algorithm randomization against oblivious adversary. The Carathéodory oracle may not be polynomial (paper says the problem is NP-hard), so compute not_stated.

bound.expression_latex: \widetilde O\!\left(\frac{D_{\underline b}K m}{T^{1/4}}+\frac{S_{\underline b}\mathsf{K}^2K\sqrt m}{D_{\underline b}T^{3/4}}\right) + \min_{b\in[\underline b,\bar b]} \Big(4K\widehat V_b\sqrt{2m}+bm\Big)

symbols.S_b: S_{underline b}: max Hessian norm of the barrier over the b-restricted set

symbols.V_b: barrier-divergence task-similarity measure hat V_b at offset b
symbols.b: boundary offset; the last two terms are minimised over b in [underline b, bar b]

tuning: eta = hat V_b/(2 sqrt(32) K m)
grid size k = O~(D_b^2 K sqrt(m T))

source.label: thm:obp-bandit-meta1
